name: Lavender

schedule.notes: Buy plants — seed is unreliable and slow. Set at original soil line; deeper buries the crown.
Cut stems when half the buds on a spike are open for the strongest scent.

harvest.cues: Buds plump and showing color; about half the buds on a spike are open.
harvest.storageNotes: Hang bundles upside down in shade 2 to 3 weeks. Buds rub off easily for sachets and culinary use.

varieties.name: Munstead
varieties.notes: Compact 18 in, very cold-hardy. Sweet floral scent.

varieties.name: Hidcote
varieties.notes: Deep purple flowers, slow-growing. Classic for hedges.

varieties.name: Grosso
varieties.notes: Large, vigorous, high oil content. Less cold-hardy (zone 6+).

notes: Needs gravelly, lean, alkaline soil; rich wet soil kills it within a season. Don't mulch with bark. Prune by a third after flowering to keep tight; never cut into bare wood.
